title: The record shows only what holds
situation: The decision that asked for this was framed as a planned cut, so a fresh session read it as not started after it had been realized as ordinary engineering.
decision: The record's views show only what currently holds: standing concepts, standing decisions, standing examples, open decisions and cuts in flight. History (superseded and deprecated decisions, finished work's examples) is kept and shown only when asked for. The ledger records each assayer's verdict, so judged work shows as approved or failed.
consequences: Realized; nothing is pending under it.
